name: Shawn
source:
"I sometimes wonder if the nightmares would disappear if I learned to protect myself and others rather than always needing someone to look after me."

Luk's younger brother. He's not good at melee combat, but he is a hacker who's good at programming simple spyware and hacking networks that aren't well secured.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
